subject.title: fix(tailscale): auto-connect with authkey, detect NeedsLogin, enable Tailscale SSH

question: Should auth-key auto-connect also enable Tailscale SSH by default for new and rerun installations?
rationale: This changes the installer's remote-access boundary beyond the documented auto-connect bug, and repository security-first policy does not establish default-on Tailscale SSH as intended product behavior.

options.title: Make SSH opt-in
options.body: Default `tailscale_ssh` to false and enable `--ssh` only when an operator explicitly requests it.

options.title: Keep default-on SSH
options.body: Accept the broader remote-access default with explicit security documentation and live ACL-aware proof.

options.title: Drop SSH from this PR
options.body: Land only the auth-key and BackendState repair, leaving Tailscale SSH for a separately reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Make SSH opt-in
recommendation.body: Default `tailscale_ssh` to false and enable `--ssh` only when an operator explicitly requests it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository integration and role-boundary history make alauppe the best available owner for the installer-wide security default.
